description: This file defines classes and functions for monitoring and intercepting network requests in Firefox, including handling request lifecycle events, request interception, response storage, and security details, as part of the Mozilla codebase for network observation.

classes.name: PageNetwork
classes.description: Manages network requests and responses for a specific page target, including request interception and response storage.

classes.name: NetworkRequest
classes.description: Represents an individual network request, handling interception, response data, and event emission.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Observes network activity, manages request lifecycle, redirects, and integrates with Firefox's networking components.

classes.name: ResponseStorage
classes.description: Stores response bodies with size limits, providing retrieval in base64 encoding.

methods.name: forPageTarget
methods.description: Returns or creates a PageNetwork instance for a given target.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers to be sent with requests.

methods.name: combinedExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Returns combined extra HTTP headers from target and internal state.

methods.name: enableRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables request interception.

methods.name: disableRequestInterception
methods.description: Disables request interception and resumes intercepted requests.

methods.name: resumeInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Resumes a paused intercepted request with new parameters.

methods.name: fulfillInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Fulfills an intercepted request with specified response data.

methods.name: abortInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Aborts an intercepted request with an error code.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body for a request in base64 encoding.

methods.name: _takeIntercepted
methods.description: Removes and returns an intercepted request by requestId.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a NetworkRequest instance, setting up request details and interception.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused request with new URL, method, headers, and postData.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a request with an error code.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a request with status, headers, and body.

methods.name: _onInternalRedirect
methods.description: Handles internal redirect of a request.

methods.name: _onInternalRedirectReady
methods.description: Prepares request after a resumed internal redirect.

methods.name: getInterface
methods.description: Provides requested XPCOM interface, mainly for authentication and interception control.

methods.name: getAuthPrompt
methods.description: Returns the authentication prompt interface.

methods.name: asyncPromptAuth
methods.description: Asynchronously prompts for authentication credentials.

methods.name: promptAuth
methods.description: Provides credentials for authentication if available.

methods.name: shouldPrepareForIntercept
methods.description: Determines if a request should be prepared for interception.

methods.name: channelIntercepted
methods.description: Handles intercepted channel, possibly yielding to service worker or proceeding with interception.

methods.name: onDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles incoming data chunks for a request.

methods.name: onStartRequest
methods.description: Handles start of request.

methods.name: onStopRequest
methods.description: Handles end of request, storing response or handling errors.

methods.name: _sendOnRequest
methods.description: Emits request event with request details.

methods.name: _sendOnResponse
methods.description: Emits response event with response details.

methods.name: _sendOnRequestFailed
methods.description: Emits request failed event.

methods.name: _sendOnRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits request finished event.
